levels.surface: محمد بن عبد الله بن نمير
يزيد بن عبد الله بن قسيط
داود بن عامر بن سعد بن أبي وقاص

notes: The chain ends at «عن أبيه» (Dawud's father), a bare relation; the report then tells a scene at Ibn Umar's (place, not link).
Abu Hurayra's saying is quoted by Khabbab inside the scene; whether he is a further link is a rule-6 judgement, so the report is held for ruling rather than given a link I cannot place.
